description: Tickets — possession of a NAMED api key is identity. An operator mints a named low-trust key and hands it to an outside user; the key-holder files tickets (requests/questions, optionally with media) that live as type-`ticket` documents with an embedded append-only message thread; the operator answers from Studio/CLI, and the key-holder retrieves the answer with the SAME key. Status IS the turn indicator (open = operator's move, answered = submitter's move, closed = done; a submitter reply auto-reopens).
